declarations.docstring: An auxiliary type indexed by a natural number, a finitely supported function on `Fin N`, and a permutation of `Fin n`.
An auxiliary type indexed by a natural number and two functions from `Fin N` to natural numbers.
The specified multivariate-polynomial coefficient equals the cardinality of the auxiliary type indexed by the finitely supported function and permutation.
For finitely supported functions of total weight `n`, the sum of products of auxiliary cardinalities equals `n!` times the cardinality of the function-pair auxiliary type.
Under the displayed coordinate bounds, the specified multivariate-power-series coefficient equals the cardinality of the function-pair auxiliary type.
A finite-type structure for the auxiliary type indexed by a finitely supported function and a permutation.
A finite-type structure for the auxiliary type indexed by two functions from `Fin N` to natural numbers.
Mapping the auxiliary multivariate power series along a ring homomorphism gives the corresponding auxiliary power series.
For finitely supported functions of total weight `n`, the sum of products of the displayed polynomial coefficients equals `n!` times the displayed multivariate-power-series coefficient.
